correctness.method: `eslint .` and `pnpm run typecheck` (pnpm -r typecheck -> tsc --noEmit per package) run locally against main@45d0c64 (HEAD of capturedFromCommit) with the exact dependency versions pinned in pnpm-lock.yaml. typecheckErrors amended 2026-07-23 (rig#17): the original capture read 1, but `pnpm -r` bails at the FIRST package whose script fails, so with packages/rig's single error unfixed it never reached packages/rig-web and silently never ran rig-web's own `tsc --noEmit` -- the recorded '1' only ever reflected packages/rig, not the whole gate-visible surface. rig#17 fixed that one packages/rig error (src/cli/output.ts TS2345), which unmasked packages/rig-web's pre-existing, unrelated 154 errors (already tracked, out of scope, as the rig-web bucket in rig#3) now that `pnpm -r typecheck` runs to completion. No error count actually increased -- rig-web's debt predates this capture and this change; it was simply never exercised by the aggregate command before. Corrected here so the frozen baseline matches the true, now fully-run count and rig-web's real debt stays governed by the no-regression guard going forward instead of remaining invisible to it. Ratcheted 154 -> 135 on 2026-07-25 (rig#24, slice 2 of #3's burndown): fixed all 19 non-test src errors in packages/rig-web/src/web/relay-client.ts (16x TS4111, narrowed decodeEventFallback's Record<string,unknown> scratch object to a real NostrEvent object literal at its validation boundary instead of dot-accessing an index-signature type) and src/web/components/error-boundary.tsx (3x TS4114, added `override` to state/componentDidCatch/render). Lowering the baseline locks the fix in so a future PR can't silently reintroduce these 19 errors under the <= guard. Amended again 2026-07-25 (rig#28): excluded the dead, unrunnable tests/e2e/seed/** harness from packages/rig-web's tsconfig (and from eslint's typed-lint surface, since files outside every tsconfig's `include` fail projectService parsing). It was rebased onto main AFTER rig#24 (which had already taken typecheck 154 -> 135) and re-measured, so the stale branch-authored figures were discarded and replaced with the counts actually observed by the CI correctness gate on the rebased head (run 30167403874): eslint 4e/218w, typecheck 3e. The typecheck figure is a genuine full-surface count, not a `pnpm -r` early-bail artifact -- verified by running `pnpm -r typecheck` to completion on the rebased tree: packages/rig passes and packages/rig-web reports exactly 3 remaining TS2307s (the stale test imports that rig#25 fixes). Baseline tightened to the measured values so the <= guard exercises the real, post-exclusion surface with no unearned slack. Amended again 2026-07-25 (rig#25, slice 3 of the rig#3 burndown): fixed the 3 stale TS2307 test imports in packages/rig-web (2 wrong relative paths to nip34-parsers.ts in clone-instructions.test.tsx / repo-list-page.test.tsx, 1 dead @toon-protocol/sdk import removed with its unused mock factory in pubkey-identity.test.ts), plus the RepoListEntry retyping of the repo-list mock factory that fixing the import unmasked. NOTE ON THE NUMBERS: this branch was authored against the pre-rig#24 main and originally recorded 154 -> 151. It was rebased onto main after BOTH rig#24 and rig#28 landed (which together had already taken typecheck to 3) and re-measured rather than trusting the stale figure. Measured on the rebased head with a complete `pnpm -r typecheck` from a clean, dist-free tree: both packages/rig and packages/rig-web now report Done -- typecheck 3 -> 0, the whole repo typechecks clean. eslint is unchanged at 4e/218w (verified via `eslint . -f json`); the remaining 4 errors are rig#30's scope.
